raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the 58th quadrennial U.S. presidential election as 2020; the 58th was the 2016 election (held after the March 8, 2016 Michigan Democratic primary), while 2020 was the 59th, and prematurely marked the task complete without proper verification.
